scope.nuget: All direct and transitive package versions resolved for the eight repository csproj files, net10.0, without executing tests. All platform native packages selected by the restore graph are retained. Framework/runtime packs are external distribution components, not silently covered by NuGet package declarations.
scope.npm: Complete package-lock.json v3 graph including dev/test/optional/platform nodes; package tarballs fetched only to scratch and verified against lock integrity. Peer edges include optional peers that may remain absent.
scope.native: Complete upstream notice files found in packages are retained; native component sections are observations, not a complete per-RID linked-component audit.
scope.external: Selected tools and model upstream license declarations. Installed binary/quantized model hashes and their full bundled dependencies are not inventoried.
